crossRefs.note: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel.…
I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will…
I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
You will also be a crown of beauty in Yahweh‘s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

translations.web: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; and I would bind it to me as a crown.
translations.bsb: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder and wear it like a crown.
translations.kjv: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown
translations.asv: Surely I would carry it upon my shoulder; I would bind it unto me as a crown:
